highlights.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
highlights.summary: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

highlights.title: Live Updates: Investigators Seek to Establish Motive in FlyDubai Attack
highlights.summary: The United Arab Emirates said it would lead the investigation, including into possible links to terrorism. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel said the attacker had undergone “Islamist radical indoctrination,” though he did not elaborate.

highlights.title: Christa Pike in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections, lawyer says
highlights.summary: Pike’s lawyers have asked for her death sentence to be commuted following the botched execution.

highlights.title: Netanyahu diz que homem que atacou piloto tem “radicalização islâmica”
highlights.summary: Premiê acredita que copiloto pretendia derrubar avião com passageiros a bordo; investigação está em andamento

highlights.title: Cornell rape allegations renew push to change New York sexual assault law
highlights.summary: New York law treats intoxicated victims differently depending on whether they willingly consumed alcohol or drugs.

highlights.title: Católicos mais com Lula, evangélicos mais com Flávio: o que as pesquisas mostram sobre a batalha do voto e as religiões
highlights.summary: A preferência por Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro segue um padrão visto em 2022, mas com diferenças importantes. Pesquisadores explicam o que mudou e quais fatores podem ser decisivos no fim da corrida eleitoral.
